answer: Propose one vote per pass for each ID relaying 1 GiB of disjoint customer traffic to an island haven during a satellite's zenith pass. Validators match source/sink signatures on pass/ID-bound byte ranges and reject reuse. Missing, late or invalid receipts mean no vote. Bandwidth is a recurring cost; radios are reusable capital. Sharing or parallelism cannot credit bytes twice. Colluding endpoints can fake delivery; this prices service, not unique owners. With a proposed aggregate 10 GiB pass budget, ten IDs exhaust capacity; extra aliases earn nothing.
